marketRegime.rationale: European business sentiment improves per Reuters survey, but US tariff threats on Mexico and Canada, Middle East oil volatility, and Spanish labour unrest create offsetting headwinds; macro data mixed across regions.

executivePulse.title: Spain Labour Shock
executivePulse.text: First general strike in 14 years before hundreds of thousands joined protests over housing costs; government approves reforms but duration tied to election outcome. Weighs on domestic demand and policy stability.

executivePulse.title: US Tariff Escalation
executivePulse.text: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Mexico over migrant caravan and announces no Iran deal needed; oil prices jump on geopolitical risk. Signals protectionist pivot ahead of 2027 investment cycle.

executivePulse.title: European Sentiment Shift
executivePulse.text: Business confidence rises but inflation worries grow per Reuters survey; Japan wholesale inflation accelerates, India CPI breaches 6% threshold. Central bank tightening cycle risk re-emerges across major economies.

houseView.label: Spain & Madrid Real Estate
houseView.change: First general strike in 14 years and nationwide housing protests force government reform approval; trajectory tied to election outcome. Supply-side caps and rent controls risk investor returns.

houseView.label: European Credit & Financing
houseView.change: Business sentiment improves per Reuters but inflation concerns resurface; central banks across Japan, India, eurozone tracking tighter cycles. Credit spreads exposed to policy pivot risk in 1-3M.

houseView.label: Private Capital Deployment
houseView.change: Sovereign wealth funds warned by IMF over technology and debt risks; PE hospital investments flagged for stability concerns. AI infrastructure capex remains dominant (Goldman), but execution risk on tariff and labour policy headwinds.

houseView.label: Energy & Commodities
houseView.change: Trump signals no Iran deal; oil prices jump on geopolitical premium and Strait control rhetoric. Nigeria hits OPEC quota sixth month; Angola diversifying windfalls. Near-term upside bias on supply tightness.

houseView.label: Emerging Markets
houseView.change: India inflation breaches 6% (RBI tightening case); Brazil inflation ticks higher post-election; Indonesia political realignment (Gibran exit weakens Widodo). Macro headwinds offset energy import tailwinds.

houseView.label: Global Risk Appetite
houseView.change: US tariff escalation on Mexico and Canada, UK-China EV friction, and Ukraine Starlink disruptions create policy uncertainty. Oil volatility and Spanish labour shock add friction; cross-asset repricing risk if tariffs broaden.

catalysts.title: Ukraine prisoner exchange trilateral (Russia-US-Ukraine); Kushner/Witkoff to Dublin meet Zelensky
ASEAN Summit: Trump arrives in Manila; Southeast Asia supply chain and trade posture signals

globalBriefing: Spanish general strike and housing reform demands signal political instability in Europe's periphery; RBI, BoJ, and India inflation data suggest convergent EM tightening cycle through Q1 2027. Trump tariff escalation on Mexico and Canada materialises with geopolitical oil premium from Iran policy stance, creating dual headwind for North American capex and inflationary pass-through to transport and industrial CPI. European business sentiment improves but policy divergence risk rises across central banks.
marketOpen: Monitor Trump tariff timing and Mexico/Canada response; watch oil opening strength on Iran policy rhetoric and gauge carry-trade unwind risk from RBI-JPY divergence signals.

macro.label: Macro & Central Banks
macro.description: Central bank decisions, inflation prints, GDP, yield curves, and FX

items.headline: European business sentiment picks up, inflation worries grow, survey finds — Reuters
items.summary: Reuters business survey reports confidence recovery but heightened inflation concerns across eurozone. No specific index number published in headline; tracks ongoing central bank tightening bias and wage-price spiral risk.
items.relevance: Signals ECB policy hold risk; euro sensitivity to Q1 2027 tightening guidance update.

items.headline: Japan wholesale inflation accelerates, keeps alive rate hike view — Reuters
items.summary: Bank of Japan wholesale price data accelerates, supporting internal debate on rate normalisation beyond current near-zero stance. Follows October CPI patterns; timeline for BOJ tightening remains 1-3M window.
items.relevance: BOJ policy divergence from Fed creates yen hedging demand; impacts carry trades and Asian bond positioning.

items.headline: India's inflation breaches central bank's 6% limit, bolsters case for rate hikes — Reuters
items.summary: India CPI exceeds RBI's 6% upper tolerance band; central bank likely to resume tightening cycle. Rupee weakens on inflation signal; traders await official RBI guidance on hike magnitude and pace.
items.relevance: RBI tightening will slow India growth, emerging market asset outflows risk; USD/INR upside to 85.50+.

items.headline: Shorter workweek could add 0.3 point to inflation in 2027 — Valor International
items.summary: Analysis estimates productivity loss from reduced working hours would add ~30 basis points to eurozone CPI in 2027. Preliminary modelling; policy adoption uncertain across EU member states.
items.relevance: If labour market tightening persists, wage inflation amplifier; ECB medium-term rate path risk.

items.headline: AI spending helps lift UK growth to fastest since early 2024 — 93.3 The Drive
items.summary: UK economic growth accelerates on AI capex and technology sector momentum, strongest pace in ~18 months. BOE rate path implications if domestic demand and inflation remain sticky.
items.relevance: BOE hold bias may extend if growth outperforms; sterling upside; UK real rates compression.

macro.keyTakeaway: If BoJ, RBI, and ECB all signal tightening through Q1 2027 while Fed pauses, USD and rates volatility will spike; real asset and emerging market growth equities face headwind.

geopolitics.label: Geopolitics & Security
geopolitics.description: Conflicts, alliances, sanctions, and power shifts

items.headline: Ukraine says military Starlink disrupted again as US envoys meet Putin in Moscow; Kushner and Witkoff to meet Zelensky in Dublin
items.summary: Trilateral Russia-Ukraine-US negotiations confirm prisoner exchange but yield no peace framework. US envoy signal-sending to both capitals; Starlink disruption suggests ongoing infrastructure warfare.
items.relevance: War-duration uncertainty prolongs energy sanctions, supply-chain friction, and European defence capex; M&A and FDI into Eastern Europe remain suppressed.

items.headline: Trump says no Iran deal needed; oil prices jump — CNBC, WSJ, OilPrice.com
items.summary: Trump statement rules out Iran nuclear deal negotiation; signals containment-via-military posture. Oil front-month contract rises; markets price in tighter supply and Strait of Hormuz risk premium.
items.relevance: Oil supply tightness supports energy capex in Gulf and Africa; inflation pass-through risk to transportation and industrial CPI; emerging market energy import bills rise.

items.headline: 'No war, no peace': Can Iran break the deadlock with the US? — Al Jazeera
items.summary: Analysis assesses Iran-US standoff as inherently unstable equilibrium; experts flag slow-motion escalation risk. Mirrors market-pricing of heightened geopolitical premium.
items.relevance: Extends horizon of Middle East supply disruption risk into 2027; structural oil bid supports energy real assets.

items.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills six Palestinians; Gaza doctor killed as Israel expands war on healthcare — BBC, Al Jazeera
items.summary: Escalating Israeli military operations target healthcare infrastructure in Gaza. Multiple sources confirm medical system collapse affecting patient care and staff retention.
items.relevance: Humanitarian crisis deepens; regional instability spillover risk; ESG-sensitive capital may divest from Israeli equities and regional operators.

items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid spy scandal and market loss; Nvidia loses over $600bn in market value
items.summary: Nvidia announces CEO resignation linked to espionage and affair allegations; market cap loss exceeds $600 billion. Geopolitical intelligence risk and leadership vacuum weigh on US tech sector confidence.
items.relevance: Tech sector governance and espionage risk perception; AI supply chain concentration worry; US-China competitive intelligence spillover.

geopolitics.keyTakeaway: If Middle East escalation and China-US tech espionage risks persist, oil rallies, tech valuations compress, and cross-border M&A deal velocity slows; European defence and energy real assets gain relative appeal.

fdi.label: FDI & Capital Flows
fdi.description: Cross-border investments, sovereign wealth, and capital movements

items.headline: AI to stay dominant force behind US business investment in 2027, Goldman says — Reuters
items.summary: Goldman Sachs forecasts US business capex will remain AI-focused throughout 2027. Estimates imply $500B+ annual allocation to compute infrastructure and software; concentration in mega-cap tech and semiconductor supply chain.
items.relevance: US FDI into Europe and emerging markets stays subdued; capital flows to US accelerate if tariff walls rise; private equity AI plays attract dry powder deployment.

items.headline: South Korea's Lee says Samsung chip packaging expansion to spur $30 billion additional investment — Reuters
items.summary: Samsung announces $30 billion capex commitment on back of chip packaging capacity expansion. Signals confidence in semiconductor cycle recovery; South Korea positioned as advanced node supplier.
items.relevance: Asian semiconductor FDI surge continues; Japan and Taiwan follow; US capex repatriation faces competition from Korea cost-efficiency.

items.headline: Kia India plans $2 billion investment in second plant, targets 2030 production kickoff — Reuters
items.summary: Kia announces $2 billion capex for second Indian manufacturing facility with 2030 timeline. India auto sector remains magnet for global OEM investment despite inflation headwinds.
items.relevance: India FDI resilience despite RBI tightening; long-cycle auto capex immune to near-term rate risk; nearshoring narrative supports Asia consolidation.

items.headline: IMF warns sovereign wealth funds over technology, debt risks — Channel Africa
items.summary: IMF signals caution to SWFs on technology-sector concentration and sovereign debt sustainability. Flags portfolio rebalancing pressure and crowding risk in AI-adjacent assets.
items.relevance: Sovereign wealth fund deployment velocity may slow; emerging market and private capital allocators reduce tech overweight; emerging market credit spreads widen if SWF demand softens.

items.headline: Sovereign Wealth Funds Boost AI Investments, Shaping Global Economy — Global Banking & Finance Review
items.summary: Multiple SWFs increase AI and advanced technology allocations, signaling long-term secular conviction. Counterbalances IMF caution narrative; suggests bifurcated SWF strategy (core AI, cautious elsewhere).
items.relevance: AI infrastructure and semiconductor plays attract permanent capital; less sensitive to rate cycles; emerging market diversification plays lose relative appeal.

fdi.keyTakeaway: If US tariff threats broaden beyond Mexico-Canada, non-US FDI flows to emerging markets and Europe may decelerate; concentration of capital in US AI and Korean semiconductor capex continues.

critical-minerals.label: Commodities & Energy
critical-minerals.description: Oil, gas, metals, supply chains, and energy security

items.headline: Trump says no Iran deal needed; oil prices jump — CNBC, WSJ, OilPrice.com
items.summary: Trump rules out Iran nuclear deal; markets price containment posture and Strait of Hormuz supply risk. Oil front-month rises; traders embed geopolitical premium into forward curves.
items.relevance: Energy capex in Gulf and Africa encouraged; hedging demand for oil volatility and LNG contracts rises; transport and industrial CPI passthrough risk.

items.headline: Nigeria hits OPEC oil production quota for sixth straight month — OilPrice.com
items.summary: Nigeria achieves 1.51 million barrels per day in October, meeting OPEC allocation for sixth consecutive month. Supply recovery reduces cartel discipline risk and lowers geopolitical price premium.
items.relevance: If Nigeria output stability holds, OPEC supply floor rises; oil price rally may moderate; Africa energy export revenue strengthens.

items.headline: Angola looks to diversify from crude with windfall oil revenues — OilPrice.com
items.summary: Angola deploys current oil windfall into transport, minerals and non-energy sectors. Signals commodity cycle peak and portfolio rebalancing toward energy transition and minerals.
items.relevance: Africa minerals capex and infrastructure uplift; mining equity valuations support long-cycle demand; commodity diversification trade.

items.headline: India boosts Gulf oil imports as Russian crude loses its price advantage — OilPrice.com
items.summary: India imports higher volumes from Persian Gulf than Russia in November, first time since Iran war erupted. Supply chain normalisation underway; Russian discount erodes as sanctions impact fades.
items.relevance: India energy security improves; Russian petro-leverage declines; Gulf producers gain market share and pricing power.

items.headline: Endeavour bets $1.2 billion on major Ivory Coast gold mine; targets 320,000 oz annually — Mining.com
items.summary: Endeavour Resources commits $1.2 billion capex to Ivory Coast gold development; production ramp targets 320,000 oz/year. Development costs rising 13% on inflation; long-cycle capex thesis holds.
items.relevance: West Africa gold supply trajectory supports long-cycle commodity upside; mining equity capex acceleration benefits equipment and services suppliers.

critical-minerals.keyTakeaway: If oil geopolitical premium and gold hedging demand persist through 2027, energy and precious metals capex sustains; Russian crude discount continues eroding as sanctions normalise.

real-estate.label: Real Estate & Infrastructure
real-estate.description: Institutional RE, infrastructure projects, and market trends

items.headline: Spain approves housing reforms after nationwide strike over costs; first general strike in 14 years — Al Jazeera, DW, NYT, Time
items.summary: Spanish government approves housing measures following first general strike in 14 years and nationwide protests. Hundreds of thousands mobilised over affordability crisis; reform trajectory depends on election outcome.
items.source: Al Jazeera, DW, NYT, Time Magazine
items.relevance: Supply-side caps and rent controls materialise; investor returns on Madrid and Barcelona residential compress; political instability risks broader policy reversals post-election.

items.headline: Turkey agrees to record $1.6 billion climate policy funding deal with AIIB — OilPrice.com
items.summary: Turkey and Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank announce $1.6 billion climate-focused financing package, largest deal of type. Supports Turkey's climate and infrastructure goals; broadens AIIB Middle East footprint.
items.relevance: Turkey infrastructure real assets attract multilateral capital; energy transition capex de-risks currency volatility; Middle East infra investors gain AIIB co-investment optionality.

items.headline: Seven Hills Realty Trust closes two first mortgage loans totaling $74.2 million — Business Wire
items.summary: Regional US REIT closes dual mortgage transactions totalling $74.2 million. Commercial real estate financing continues but selective on credit quality and asset class.
items.relevance: US CRE lending conditions remain tight; sponsor capital and debt financing available for prime assets only; secondary market pricing compressed.

real-estate.keyTakeaway: If Spanish housing policy caps persist, Madrid and Barcelona residential yields compress 100-150 bps; Turkey infra capex provides emerging market real asset alternative.

ma-growth.label: M&A & Private Capital
ma-growth.description: Deal flow, PE/VC activity, and corporate transactions

items.headline: Why Pfizer is tapping private equity to back its once-monthly weight-loss drug — Barron's
items.summary: Pfizer enlists PE backing for GLP-1 asset development and commercialisation. Signals PE appetite for biotech co-investment and royalty structures; reduces sponsor capex on single-molecule risk.
items.relevance: PE deployment into healthcare capex and IP licensing structures grows; sponsor dry powder favours royalty and co-investment partnerships over full acquisitions.

items.headline: Private equity's hospital investments raise concerns around financial stability — HealthLeaders Media
items.summary: Analysis flags PE ownership of hospital networks and risks to operational and financial stability. Debt-driven models and profit extraction concern regulators and patient advocates.
items.relevance: Healthcare real asset and PE returns under policy and reputational scrutiny; ESG-sensitive LPs divest from hospital sponsor portfolios; sponsor exit valuations face headwind.

items.headline: Zydus closes $166M Assertio buyout for US oncology foothold — Dealroom
items.summary: Zydus Pharma completes $166 million acquisition of Assertio Therapeutics, gaining US oncology portfolio and commercial platform. Cross-border pharma M&A activity continues.
items.relevance: Emerging market pharma sponsor consolidation into US oncology; cross-border M&A valuations and deal velocity supported by IP and regulatory runway.

items.headline: Major waste companies spent $1.2B on Q3 M&A, driven by GFL — Waste Dive
items.summary: Waste services M&A totalled $1.2 billion in Q3 2026, led by GFL Environmental consolidation play. Sector valuations remain attractive on stable cash generation and ESG tailwinds.
items.relevance: Defensive infrastructure M&A supports sponsor returns amid rate volatility; waste sector remains PE-favouring on predictable EBITDA and capex optionality.

items.headline: VCs chase protein as fake meat falls out of favour — Crunchbase News
items.summary: Venture capital pivots from meat substitutes to protein fortification across packaged food and beverage categories. Market reallocation away from failed category; innovation capital follows consumer trend.
items.relevance: Early-stage agrifood capex rotates; protein tech and supplementation plays attract dry powder; meat alternative sponsor portfolios face repricing risk.

ma-growth.keyTakeaway: If PE healthcare risk perceptions worsen, hospital portfolio exit valuations compress 15-20%; pharma M&A and co-investment deals sustain as higher-conviction deployment buckets.

emerging-markets.label: Emerging Markets
emerging-markets.description: Frontier opportunities, risk signals, and market access

items.headline: India's economy is holding up, but economists see headwinds building for FY28 — CNBC TV18
items.summary: India GDP growth remains resilient but forward estimates weaken for FY28 (starting April 2027) on RBI tightening impact, wage inflation, and external current account pressures.
items.relevance: India capex story remains 2027 intact but growth deceleration risk emerges; EM currency hedging costs rise on RBI rate differential; emerging market growth-equity allocators rotate.

items.headline: Brazil's inflation ticks up after Lula's win rattles markets — Bloomberg
items.summary: Brazil CPI data shows uptick following Lula's recent political win. Market pricing suggests fiscal and wage-price concerns on re-election; central bank tightening bias likely.
items.relevance: Brazil real depreciation risk widens; EM currency volatility and carry trade unwinding potential; emerging market fixed income spreads widen.

items.headline: Prabowo gains upper hand as Gibran's exit weakens Widodo's grip — Asia Times
items.summary: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigns, shifting balance toward President Prabowo Subianto and away from predecessor Widodo faction. Political recalibration underway.
items.relevance: Indonesia policy uncertainty decreases if Prabowo consolidates; business confidence and FDI sentiment improve; infrastructure capex timeline clarifies.

items.headline: ASEAN real wants from Trump at the Manila summit — Asia Times
items.summary: Southeast Asia faces Trump arrival at ASEAN summit with heightened focus on supply chain diversification, trade terms, and security commitments. Positions region as geopolitical focal point.
items.relevance: Nearshoring and US trade preference signals will shape EM FDI and manufacturing capex flows; supply-chain de-risking narratives support Vietnam and Thailand capex.

emerging-markets.keyTakeaway: If RBI and central banks across EM tighten while US tariffs broaden, emerging market growth equities and currencies face 6-12M headwind; India and Indonesia relative outperform on policy clarity.

trade-policy.label: Trade & Industrial Policy
trade-policy.description: Tariffs, sanctions, export controls, and economic statecraft

items.headline: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Mexico over illegal immigration; migrants caravan sets out from southern Mexico — Reuters, FT, NYPost, Fox News
items.summary: Trump announces tariff escalation (doubling) on Mexico if migrant caravan flows continue. Al Jazeera reports caravan departing southern Mexico post-midterms with migrant hope for entry. Dual pressure on Mexico tariff and labour policy.
items.relevance: Mexico export competitiveness damaged if tariffs double; nearshoring narratives suffer; cross-border supply chains face pricing pressure and routing uncertainty.

items.headline: Canadian hockey sticks, wine and cement subject to new Trump tariffs — News From The States
items.summary: Trump tariff list expands to Canadian consumer goods and materials (hockey sticks, wine, cement). Signals sectoral rather than categorical approach; supply-chain breadth of tariff application widens.
items.relevance: Canada cross-border trade disrupted; forestry, beverages, and construction materials capex in North America face input cost shock; substitution and nearshoring urgency rises.

items.headline: China-EU relations need cooperation, not pressure — Global Times
items.summary: Chinese editorial signals openness to EU dialogue while cautioning against protectionist pressure. Reflects Beijing's preference for engagement over escalation but signals willingness to respond.
items.relevance: If EU and China avoid tariff tit-for-tat, Europe export competitiveness survives; if Trump tariffs force EU-China alignment, transatlantic trade stress rises.

items.headline: China, UK discuss EVs after Beijing warns against trade restrictions — CnEVPost
items.summary: China and UK governments discuss EV trade terms; Beijing warns against import restrictions. Bilateral negotiation underway; reflects sectoral tariff concern ahead of broader policy.
items.relevance: EV supply-chain tariff risk materialises in EU and UK markets; Tesla and Chinese BYD valuations face regional tariff scenario hedging.

trade-policy.keyTakeaway: If Trump tariff threats on Mexico and Canada execute at announced doubling rate, North American cross-border supply chains face 10-15% cost shock; nearshoring acceleration accelerates into 2027.

food-agriculture.label: Food & Agriculture
food-agriculture.description: Food security, agribusiness, and agricultural commodities

items.headline: Wheat and soybean futures rebound as corn slips after USDA report — AgroLatam
items.summary: USDA data triggers wheat and soy upside while corn underperforms. Supply curve dynamics suggest tightness in wheat/soy; demand concerns weigh on corn.
items.relevance: Feed and food grain price divergence signals commodity rotation; emerging market food import bills diverge by crop; agricultural capex rebalances crop selection.

items.headline: Egypt wheat production surge and global wheat price outlook — CMB News
items.summary: Egypt reports wheat production surge, adding global supply cushion. Price outlook moderates if production gains sustain; North Africa food security improves.
items.relevance: Global wheat prices face downside risk if Egypt output sustains; food-import-dependent emerging markets benefit; agricultural commodity diversification plays support.

items.headline: Iran denies cyberattacks on French supermarkets — AgFunder News
items.summary: Iran denies responsibility for cyber incidents affecting 700+ French retail food outlets. Escalating food-sector supply chain digitalisation risk and geopolitical spillover.
items.relevance: Food retail operational risk and cyber insurance demand rise; supply chain hardening capex accelerates; Iran-Europe tension signals broader infrastructure vulnerability.

items.headline: Nine breakthrough technologies redefining crop protection and future of agriculture — AgroLatam
items.summary: Overview of agritech innovation in crop protection spans pest management, disease monitoring, and yield optimisation. Sector capex and VC deployment accelerate.
items.relevance: Agritech innovation capex momentum sustained; precision agriculture and sustainability plays attract VC and corporate venture funding.

food-agriculture.keyTakeaway: If Egypt wheat surge and global grain supply stabilise, agricultural commodity inflation moderates in 2027; emerging market food import cost pressure eases.
